comment_corrections: /** Filter templates are ghosts, never stored cargo. Both insertion and extraction obey the same rule. */
/** Ghost templates select cargo; front-side capability operations bypass template selection. */

readability.limit: Whitespace and listed scoped local/parameter names, plus one source-backed explanation; no behavioral change.

reused_receipt.scope: Actual Forge47.4.20/Neo21.1.243 default conductor and native signal merging from batch82; recheck saved input hashes.

finite_source_witnesses.kind: Finite source-contract analysis, no native target or world execution.

routing.limit: Four filter profiles, opposite front/secondary settings, six queries; not all wrench/secondary combinations.

right_click.condition: Empty cursor, tagged ordinary item ghost, right click
Empty cursor, untagged ordinary item ghost, right click
right_click.original: Retain item and set metadata wildcard

right_click.condition: Nonempty cursor, valid ordinary item, right click
Empty cursor, fluid display ghost, right click

prefix_display_cycle.condition: Selected prefix has registered entries; original tick phase1 schedules a random family representative, current no template cycle ticker. Random selection may repeat the same item.
prefix_display_cycle.limit: Callback/display consumer evidence only; no measured screen animation or prefix-registry initialization.

conduction_extension.limit: Four no-cover full filter cubes with one oriented powered lever and another output face. Extends277 using batch82 native artifacts; original side is the explicit weak-power opt-out contract.

finite_source_witnesses.rejected_material_fluid_shortcut: Original OreDictMaterial.fluid(U,true) dispatches at DEF_ENV_TEMP; it is not synonymous with liquid/molten. Do not claim a copper ingot necessarily selects molten copper or restore FL.Error fallback as a correct feature.

positive_routes: Four registered types have shared native capability entry and real menu/screen registration on both platforms.
54 ghost templates or one prefix selector, matching ordinary empty whitelist/blacklist, front bypass, and unconditionally allowed valid fluid in prefix mode agree with source paths.
Current soft hammer clears templates and resets whitelist; screwdriver/button toggles mode. Ghost slots are protected from pickup/drag/swap extraction and should remain protected.
Native save/load and getDrops capture templates/mode; CoverDrops machine-removal branch excludes FilterBlockEntity. No actual re-placement/restart is accepted by that source path.
Filter has no own getCover, so actual fallback uses the selected side and wraps native operations; do not copy extender275/276 onto this host.
remaining: Actual old metadata wildcard and modern flattened identities/components mapping, alternate prefix selection/membership, material-to-fluid fallback at ambient temperature, tool fee/magnifier feedback, full secondary/wrench/placement matrix, third-party inventories, actual transfers/screens/drops/restart and full project queue.
limits: No Java compilation/initialization, Gradle, tests, game, screen render, save fixture, build or push; two javap views inspect saved mapped upstream classes only.
Readability changes preserve all eight platform execution and literal streams; template/action gameplay differences are recorded and not fixed.
Full original-alignment and readability goal remains active.
previous_goal_turn: Progress: local commit d711cb220 standardized three signal views and recorded277/278/279 with actual native signal consumers.

root_validation.limit: Read-only files and finite source conditions; no target Java compilation/initialization, Gradle, tests, game, screen, transfer/drop/restart, build or push.
